title: Multi-Head Recurrent Memory Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.01523v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recurrent memory agents extend LLMs to arbitrarily long contexts by iteratively consolidating input into a fixed-size memory window. Despite their scalability, these agents exhibit a well-documented reliability problem: end-to-end performance degrades systematically as context length grows. We diagnose this failure by decomposing performance into two factors---memory capture and memory retention---and quantitatively confirm that retention is the dominant bottleneck. Retention collapses because existing designs maintain memory as a monolithic text block, forcing every update to risk overwriting previously retained content. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Multi-Head Recurrent Memory (MHM), a general, training-free framework that partitions memory into independent heads governed by a stage-wise select-then-update strategy. translated_abstract: 循环记忆智能体通过将输入迭代地整合到固定大小的记忆窗口中，将大语言模型（LLM）扩展到任意长的上下文。尽管具备可扩展性，这类智能体存在一个有据可查的可靠性问题：随着上下文长度的增长，端到端性能会系统性下降。我们通过将性能分解为两个因素——记忆捕获和记忆保持——来诊断这一失败，并定量证实记忆保持是主导瓶颈。记忆保持之所以崩溃，是因为现有设计将记忆维护为单一的文本块，迫使每次更新都面临覆盖之前保留内容的风险。基于这一诊断，我们提出了多头循环记忆（MHM），这是一个通用的、无需训练的框架，它将记忆划分为独立的记忆头，并由分阶段的“先选择后更新”策略加以控制。在每一步中，恰好选择一个记忆头进行更新，而其余记忆头在结构上受到保护（免于被修改）。
tldr: 该论文诊断出循环记忆智能体性能随上下文增长而退化的瓶颈在于记忆保持而非记忆捕获，并提出无需训练的多头循环记忆（MHM）框架，通过将记忆划分为独立记忆头并采用“先选择后更新”策略保护未被选中的记忆免遭覆盖，从而显著提升长上下文的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies memory retention (rather than memory capture) as the dominant bottleneck behind the degradation of recurrent memory agents on long contexts, and proposes Multi-Head Recurrent Memory (MHM), a general, training-free framework that partitions memory into independent heads governed by a stage-wise select-then-update strategy to shield unselected heads from being overwritten.
